tasks.short: Classify hazardous waste, sign the consignment, and match the disposal receipt.

steps.what: Classify the hazardous waste from the laboratory description.

loop.input: The laboratory description and the code list
loop.output: A proposed waste code with the matching phrase
loop.check: The manager checks the phrase against the description
loop.stop: One pass; two plausible codes stop for the manager
loop.why_not_simpler: Descriptions are prose and borderline loads match more than one code

steps.what: Book a licensed carrier and a permitted disposal site.
Prepare the hazardous waste consignment note.
Supervise loading and sign the consignment for disposal.
Haul the hazardous waste to the permitted site.
Match the disposal receipt to the signed consignment.

tasks.design: A code is proposed from the laboratory description and checked by the manager. The consignment is prepared from that code and a booking on the approved list. The manager signs at loading, and the receipt is matched later. The carrier's haul is not the manager's work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Codes and consignments were retyped from the certificate, and a missing receipt surfaced late.
tasks.enabler_now: A description can propose a code, and a receipt can be matched to a note. Watching the load is physical.
tasks.still_hard: Refusing a load whose description and whose appearance do not match.
tasks.human_edge: The manager sees the drums, not only the code.

ambition.what: A load is signed only when the code, the carrier and the site are the ones on the checked consignment.

tasks.altitude: Loading stays on the week. Retyping the note shrinks. The manager can refuse to sign a load that does not match the note.

reach.task: Keep the list of permitted disposal sites and carriers
reach.learn: Which carrier and which site are currently permitted for this waste code

evidence.claim: An incident record can be routed to the person in charge, which is the pattern for a disposal that does not match.
Watching a hazardous load and signing the consignment stay with a person.

assumptions: Focal role is the brownfield site manager. The carrier's haul is not the manager's saving. Boundary: from a laboratory description to a matched receipt. Treatment of the waste at the destination is the site's work.
Structured fields are waste code, quantity, carrier, destination and consignment id. The laboratory description and the approved list produce them. Fallback: two plausible codes stop the booking.
Configure the approved carrier list on {WORKFLOW} before custom code.
Upkeep of 5 hours per 100 baseline hours covers codes and carriers when the permitted list changes.
National waste rules decide the legal code. This design proposes a code; the manager signs it.
unknowns: Whether the code list and the permitted sites are already maintained.
Whether the manager is the person who must sign the consignment.
research_questions: What share of loads match a single code without a doubt?
How often does the receipt fail to match the consignment?

incremental.description: Update codes and permitted sites when the list changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: descriptions are ambiguous and most loads are watched in full, so the code proposal saves little. High: codes are obvious and the note and the match shrink. Loading and the signature stay. The haul is not saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan sustainable regeneration and commit only to benefits the workshop accepted.

steps.what: Gather regeneration constraints and the benefits already on file.

loop.input: Constraints, the reuse goal and the local needs note
loop.output: Brief rows: benefit, who it is for, and the constraint it must respect
loop.check: The manager checks each benefit against the source note
loop.stop: One pass; a benefit with no audience stays blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Needs are written as prose, not as a benefit catalogue

steps.what: Workshop regeneration options with the landowner and neighbours.
Draft the sustainable regeneration note from the workshop decisions.

loop.output: A note that states only benefits the workshop accepted
loop.check: The manager deletes a benefit the workshop did not accept
loop.stop: One draft; an unaccepted benefit is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The note must follow what was said, which is not a template

steps.what: Commit to the environmental and social benefits the project will deliver.
Municipality comments on the wider regeneration area.

tasks.design: Constraints and local needs become a brief. The workshop stays in the room. The note may state only benefits the workshop accepted, and the manager commits to that version before it is treated as the plan.
tasks.previous_blocker: Benefits were copied from an old vision note, including ones this site cannot deliver.
tasks.enabler_now: A brief can list candidate benefits. Promising them to neighbours cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Refusing a benefit the room wants when the constraint list says the ground cannot support it.
tasks.human_edge: The manager hears which benefit the neighbours will actually trust.

ambition.what: Neighbours of a small site get a written benefit list that names only what this project will deliver.

tasks.altitude: Workshops stay. Drafting from memory shrinks. The manager can refuse a benefit the workshop did not accept.

reach.task: Set the benefit types the organisation is willing to promise
reach.learn: Which environmental or social benefits may be committed, and which are aspirations

evidence.claim: A drafted text that is not tied to an accepted source can state things that were never agreed.
A workshop about what a place will become stays with the people in the room.

assumptions: Focal role is the brownfield site manager. The municipality's comment is not the manager's saving. Boundary: from constraints and a workshop to a benefit commitment. Funding the benefits is a separate task.
Structured fields are benefit, audience and constraint id. The needs note and the constraint list produce them. Fallback: a benefit with no constraint id cannot be committed.
Use the {DOCS} note template before custom code.
Upkeep of 4 hours per 100 baseline hours covers benefit types the organisation adds or retires.
No digest source measures regeneration plans. Do not treat a policy library as a substitute for the workshop.
unknowns: Whether local needs are already written down or only spoken.
Whether the municipality expects to comment before the commitment.
research_questions: What share of candidate benefits are rejected in the workshop?
Who is allowed to commit a benefit, the manager or the landowner?

incremental.description: Retire benefit types the organisation no longer promises

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: needs are only spoken, so the brief is thin and the workshop is the whole task. High: needs are already noted and only the draft shrinks. The workshop and the commitment stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Run the feasibility cases and present a recommendation the numbers support.

steps.what: Build the feasibility lines from the cleanup cost and the plan.
Run the do-nothing, minimum and preferred cost cases.
Judge which benefits in the feasibility study are real.
Draft the feasibility recommendation from the judged lines.

loop.input: The benefit judgement and the case results
loop.output: A recommendation that cites a case row
loop.check: The manager deletes a benefit the judgement did not accept
loop.stop: One draft; an uncited benefit is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The recommendation is prose and must not invent a benefit

steps.what: Present the feasibility recommendation to the landowner.

tasks.design: Cost and plan lines feed three cases in {BI}. The manager judges which benefits are real, and the draft may cite only those. The landowner hears the recommendation the manager presents.
tasks.previous_blocker: Cases were rebuilt in a sheet, and benefits were mixed with the arithmetic.
tasks.enabler_now: Named cases can be recalculated from lines. Calling a benefit real cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Separating a benefit the project will deliver from one it only hopes for.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows which benefit collapses if the ground is worse than the plan.

ambition.what: Each benefit is marked real or hoped before it enters the recommendation.

tasks.altitude: The presentation stays. Recalculating standard cases shrinks. The manager can cut a benefit the judgement did not accept.

reach.task: Say which benefits may enter a feasibility case
reach.learn: Which benefits are allowed in the case and which stay qualitative

evidence.claim: Three named cases from structured cost lines are a rules calculation.
A recommendation that is not tied to the judged lines can overstate a benefit.

assumptions: Focal role is the brownfield site manager. Boundary: from priced lines and a plan to a presented recommendation. The funding submission uses this later.
Structured fields are case name, cost line, benefit and real or hoped. The cost file and the manager's judgement produce them. Fallback: a benefit with no judgement is left out of the cases.
Configure the three cases in {BI} before custom code.
Upkeep of 5 hours per 100 baseline hours covers a case definition when the organisation adds one.
This is not a social-welfare price. It uses the project's own lines.
unknowns: Whether the three cases are already the organisation's standard.
Whether the landowner expects a single number or a range.
research_questions: What share of benefits are marked hoped rather than real?
How often does the presented recommendation change the landowner's choice?

incremental.description: Adjust case definitions when the organisation adds a case

approvals.approved_version: recommendation presented from the benefit judgement

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: costs are narrative and most benefits are argued, so the cases save little and the meeting stays. High: lines exist and only the cases and the draft shrink. The benefit judgement and the presentation stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare the permit pack for cleanup or demolition and submit it signed.

steps.what: Read the permit form and the evidence each field needs.

loop.input: The permit form and its guidance
loop.output: Rows for field name, evidence required and source record
loop.check: The manager checks each field against the form
loop.stop: One pass; a field with no evidence type stays blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Forms and guidance are long, and the required evidence is not a single table

steps.what: Fill permit fields that match the site file.
Write the permit answers the form does not structure.

loop.input: The unstructured questions and the accepted plan
loop.output: Answers that cite a plan section or a field
loop.check: The manager deletes an answer that cites neither
loop.stop: One draft; an uncited answer is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: Those questions are prose and change with the permit type

steps.what: Check the permit pack against the form's required list.
Sign and submit the permit application.
Regulator asks a question on the submitted permit.

tasks.design: The form's fields are listed, and matching site-file values fill them. Narrative answers cite the accepted plan. The manager checks the pack and submits it. A later question from the regulator is still a person's work.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same site facts were retyped into each permit form.
tasks.enabler_now: A field with a matching name can be filled. An answer about why this method is safe cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Knowing which narrative answer the regulator will treat as a commitment.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows which method the permit must describe in words, not only in a code.

ambition.what: The pack is checked against the form's own required list before it is signed, not after a rejection.

tasks.altitude: Submission stays a signature. Retyping matching fields shrinks. The manager can refuse to submit a pack with a required field blank.

reach.task: Maintain the evidence each permit field must cite
reach.learn: Which evidence the current form requires for demolition, cleanup and construction

evidence.claim: A versioned obligation list can map a form's fields to the rules they answer.
Submitting a permit is an external filing and stays behind the manager's signature.

assumptions: Focal role is the brownfield site manager. The regulator's question is not the manager's saving. Boundary: from the form and the site file to a signed submission.

Structured fields are field name, value, evidence type and source record. The form defines the fields; the site file produces values. Fallback: a field with no match stays blank and blocks submission.
Use the portal's own form before building a parallel pack. Test that configuration first.
Upkeep of 6 hours per 100 baseline hours covers a form revision.
National permit rules are whatever the current form states. This design does not rename them.
unknowns: Whether the portal accepts a prefilled file or only on-screen entry.
Who is the legal applicant, the manager or the landowner.
research_questions: What share of fields match a site-file name?
How often does the regulator ask for a narrative that was left thin?

incremental.description: Update field mappings when the permit form is revised

approvals.approved_version: checked permit pack the manager signed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the form is new and most answers are narrative, so filling saves little and the check is slow. High: fields match the site file and only the narrative stays. Signing stays. Regulator time is not saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is still site walks, crew briefings and hearings. Constraint lists, permit fields and cost lines are ready before the visit. The manager can stop a method, a filing or a price that is not on a checked version.
reach: Construction managers: sequence demolition so contamination is not spread
Compliance managers: say which breaches are notified the same day
Regulatory affairs managers: keep the permit condition list current
skills_to_grow: Checking an extracted constraint against the source line
Reading a laboratory certificate without treating a blank as zero
Holding a filing or a price that is not the checked version
role.ambitious_version: Each site carries a versioned constraint list, each filing uses fields the manager has checked, and each on-site commitment stays inside a limit already signed.

job.title: Brownfield Redevelopment Specialists and Site Managers
